featured_reviews.name: Sneha Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fraud people. Pathetic service. They have taken me for just 6 lessons ans i was out of town for 5 days and they gave my slot to someone else. Which is okay as they cannot hamper business for me.
They assired they'll let me know once the slot was available again. But nothing.
After following up for months on call they asked me to go and check in office for a fresh slot. After 2 months I did go on last Sunday and the guy took one class on Monday and just did not appear the next day. Without any prior information. Has vanished again since.
So if you have patience to leave everything and keep following up. And plan to learn driving over a few years. Go here.
And now u can see the owner's reply. Beyond Pathetic.
